nodes.label: React Compiler Decision (M9-04)
nodes.rationale: Not enabled, decided 2026-08-18. Measured on this codebase: 2.7x build time (3.56s → 9.70s, median of three) and +25% on the board chunk (440 kB → 552 kB), against a re-render saving nobody had profiled. babel-plugin-react-compiler, @rolldown/plugin-babel, @babel/core and @types/babel__core were removed with it because @vitejs/plugin-react uses Oxc and nothing else needed Babel. Revisit at M9-05 once rendering is profiled.
